opis: NIGHT at the big old oak from the reference picture: a round full moon and stars, a deep blue sky, the meadow silver in the moonlight. High in the trunk the little ROUND WOODEN DOOR stands open, warm golden candle light shining out of it. In the doorway stands GRANNY OWL - an OLD owl drawn like the reference owl but with soft grey-white feathers, small round spectacles on her beak and a knitted lilac shawl round her shoulders. With both wings she holds up a child's crayon DRAWING (a sun with rays, a little house with a red roof, a tree and an orange kitten) and looks at it, deeply touched and smiling, one wing on her heart. A little lantern hangs by the door. Calm, warm, magical. Granny Owl is the ONLY animal in the picture: the reference owl only shows how owls are drawn - NO young owl, NO other animal anywhere, the meadow under the oak is empty.
